blocks.prompt: 3 (a) A company's revenue function is given by \(R(x) = 1000x - 10x^2\), where \(x\) [printed without the \(x\)] is the number of units produced. The cost function is \(C(x) = 300x + 2000\). Find the profit function \(P(x)\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh business ka sawal hai: revenue (aamdani) aur cost (kharcha) se profit (munafa).
Humein \(P(x)\) find karna hai, yani aisa formula jo kisi bhi tadaad ke units par munafa bata de.
Is part mein abhi derivative nahi lagta; yeh agle do parts ki buniyad hai, is liye isay ehtiyaat se banayein.
Plan: profit = revenue minus cost; minus kar ke milti julti terms jama karna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(R(x) = 1000x - 10x^2\), \(C(x) = 300x + 2000\). (Kitab mein "where is the number of units" chhapa hai, \(x\) reh gaya hai.)
Humein find karna hai: \(P(x)\).
Tareeqa: \(P(x) = R(x) - C(x)\). Dukaan ki misaal: din bhar mein 1000 rupay kamaye aur 700 kharch hue to munafa 300; yani aamdani minus kharcha.

Minus karein
\[P(x) = (1000x - 10x^2) - (300x + 2000)\]
\[= -10x^2 + 700x - 2000\]
Kyun: Bracket ke aage minus hai, is liye \(300x\) bhi minus aur \(2000\) bhi minus ho gaya. Phir \(1000x - 300x = 700x\).
Dhyan dein: Sirf \(300x\) ko minus kar ke \(+2000\) chhor dena aam ghalti hai; poori cost minus hoti hai.

Tasdeeq
\[x = 10:\ R = 9000,\ C = 5000\]
\[P(10) = -1000 + 7000 - 2000 = 4000 = 9000 - 5000\]
Kyun: \(x = 10\) par formula se profit 4000 aaya, aur aamdani minus kharcha bhi 4000. Formula sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 3 (b) A company's revenue function is given by \(R(x) = 1000x - 10x^2\), where \(x\) [printed without the \(x\)] is the number of units produced. The cost function is \(C(x) = 300x + 2000\). Determine the marginal profit when \(x = 15\).
blocks.explanation:
Marginal profit ka matlab hai profit ka rate of change: ek unit aur banane se munafa kitna badlega.
Humein \(P'(15)\) find karna hai.
Business wale yahi number dekh kar faisla karte hain ke production barhana faida mand hai ya nahi.
Plan: part (a) wale \(P(x)\) ko differentiate kar ke \(x = 15\) rakhna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(P(x) = -10x^2 + 700x - 2000\) (part (a) se).
Humein find karna hai: \(x = 15\) par marginal profit.
Tareeqa: Marginal profit \(= P'(x)\), yani units ke lehaz se profit ka derivative (bilkul Example 12 ki tarah). Aasaan alfaaz mein: ek unit aur banane se profit taqreeban kitna barhega.

Differentiate karein
\[P'(x) = -20x + 700\]
Kyun: \(-10x^2 \to -20x\), \(700x \to 700\), aur \(-2000\) constant hai to zero.

\(x = 15\) rakhein
\[P'(15) = -20(15) + 700\]
\[= -300 + 700 = 400\]
Kyun: Matlab 15 units par har agla unit profit mein taqreeban Rs. 400 ka izafa karta hai. Jawab positive hai, is liye abhi production barhana faida mand hai.
Dhyan dein: Pehle general \(P'(x)\) nikalein, phir value rakhein; \(P(15)\) nikal kar us ka derivative lena (constant ka derivative zero) bilkul ghalat hai.

Tasdeeq
\[P(16) - P(15) = 6640 - 6250 = 390\]
Kyun: 16wan unit banane se asal mein profit 390 barha, jo 400 ke bohat qareeb hai. Marginal profit isi "agle unit" ka andaza hota hai.

blocks.prompt: 3 (c) A company's revenue function is given by \(R(x) = 1000x - 10x^2\), where \(x\) [printed without the \(x\)] is the number of units produced. The cost function is \(C(x) = 300x + 2000\). Find the number of units that maximizes profit.
blocks.explanation:
Yeh maximum profit ka sawal hai.
Humein woh \(x\) chahiye jis par \(P(x)\) sab se zyada ho.
\(P(x)\) ka graph ulta parabola hai (\(x^2\) ka coefficient negative), is liye us ki ek hi choti hai, aur wahan slope zero hota hai.
Plan: \(P'(x) = 0\) rakh kar \(x\) nikalna, phir dono taraf \(P'\) ka sign dekhna.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(P(x) = -10x^2 + 700x - 2000\), \(P'(x) = -20x + 700\).
Humein find karna hai: maximum profit ke liye units ki tadaad.
Tareeqa: Maximum par slope zero hota hai: \(P'(x) = 0\). Phir sign se tasdeeq.

\(P'(x) = 0\) hal karein
\[-20x + 700 = 0\]
\[x = \dfrac{700}{20} = 35\]
Kyun: Profit curve ki choti par tangent horizontal hota hai, yani slope zero.

Maximum ki tasdeeq
\[x < 35:\ P'(x) > 0\]
\[x > 35:\ P'(x) < 0\]
Kyun: 35 se kam units par har naya unit profit barhata hai, 35 ke baad har naya unit profit ghatata hai (shayad kharcha zyada aur qeemat kam ho jati hai). Is liye 35 par sab se zyada profit hai.
Dhyan dein: Sawal units ki tadaad poochh raha hai, profit ki raqam nahi; jawab 35 units hai.

Tasdeeq
\[P(35) = -12250 + 24500 - 2000 = 10250\]
\[P(34) = 10240,\ P(36) = 10240\]
Kyun: 35 units par profit 10250 hai, jo 34 aur 36 dono se zyada hai. Maximum pakka.
blocks.final_answer: Profit \(x = 35\) units par maximum hai (maximum profit Rs. 10250)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key ne Exercise 13.3 ke jawabat ko 1 se 8 ke bajaye 4, 5, 6, 8, 11, 12, 13, 14 number diye hain. Is sawal ka jawab number 6 par chhapa hai: (a) \(P(x) = -10x^2 + 700x - 2000\), (b) Rs. 400, (c) 35 units, sab sahi. Sawal mein "where is the number of units produced" chhapa hai; "where" ke baad \(x\) reh gaya hai.
